subject: PO invoice slicing & tier commitment reconciliation
messages:
From: Marcus Liu <marcus.liu@terrahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: APFinance Team <ap@terrahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO formatting + invoice cadence for upcoming commitment

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to get details on how Redwood can accept our PO and invoice cadence. Two specific items:

1) PO numbering: our ERP requires a single master PO per fiscal quarter but line-level references for each invoice (format: TH-2026-Q3-<invoice_seq>). Can Redwood accept that on the invoice and on the billing metadata?

2) Invoice slicing: we typically ask vendors to issue monthly invoices for multi-month commitments instead of a single upfront invoice. That helps our cash forecasting. We're looking at a 9-month committed package here with tiered discounts tied to committed usage bands.

Also need confirmation on net terms: our AP team prefers net60 but will consider net45 with a small early-pay holdback. Can you confirm if Redwood can:
- include PO line references on each invoice
- accept monthly invoices split across the 9-month commitment
- indicate which invoice(s) correspond to which discount tranche so our ERP can map credits

I'll attach our standard PO template in a follow-up.

— Marcus

Attachment stubs referenced: PO-template_TerraHealth.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Liu <marcus.liu@terrahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO formatting + invoice cadence for upcoming commitment

Marcus —

Appreciate the clarity. Short answers up-front: yes on PO line references, and yes we can issue monthly invoices that map to committed tranches. A couple things to align on so we can produce invoices that reconcile cleanly in your ERP:

- Invoice metadata: we can populate the invoice Number, PO reference (TH-2026-Q3-1, TH-2026-Q3-2, ...), and a custom field we call "commitment_tranche" that will carry the band id (e.g., BAND-A, BAND-B). If your ERP requires different field names we can map them on our side.

- Discounting model: for the commercial offer we discussed, discounts kick in when usage crosses the tranche thresholds each month. We will include a line on the invoice showing the discount applied that month and a cumulative reconciliation line every quarter.

- Net terms: our standard for this offer is net45. For net60 requests we typically apply a 1.5% financing fee across invoices unless the customer signs a net60 addendum. If you prefer, Ben can propose a structure with an early-pay credit (0.5% for payment within 15 days) that effectively reduces the net40 economics.

I attached the SOW (v2) that includes the final band definitions and the invoice mapping section we plan to populate. Ben — can you confirm whether we want to accept net60 with the 1.5% fee, or push for net45 with an early-pay credit? Vanessa — can you note any billing ops constraints on our side for monthly tranche billing?

Thanks,
Grace

Attachment stubs: SOW-Redwood-TerraHealth-v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Liu <marcus.liu@terrahealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO formatting + invoice cadence for upcoming commitment

Marcus —

Appreciate the ask. To keep the commercial motion moving, here's what I recommend:

Option A (preferred):
- Redwood accepts monthly invoices with your PO master (TH-2026-Q3) and line refs as you described.
- We keep net45 as standard, and I will offer a one-time 2% signing discount applied pro-rata across the first three monthly invoices to acknowledge the longer cadence.

Option B (procurement preference):
- Granted net60 across invoices, Redwood applies a 1.5% financing fee across invoice amounts. We can offset some of that fee by moving one of the discount tranches earlier (i.e., BAND-A discount becomes effective in month 1 instead of month 2) — effectively accelerating a portion of the committed discount.

If either option is acceptable to Terra Health, I can update the commercial term sheet and generate a DocuSign addendum. Grace, Vanessa — we will need ops to confirm our ability to tag invoices with BAND ids and emit a quarterly reconciliation statement. Vanessa?

— Ben

(On Wed, Sep 01, 2026 at 01:40 PM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote: >)

From: Marcus Liu <marcus.liu@terrahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: APFinance Team <ap@terrahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO formatting + invoice cadence for upcoming commitment

Ben / Grace —

Thanks, both. Procurement ran the numbers with finance. We're open to Option A if you can commit to the 2% signing discount in months 1–3 and net45. That will get legal and AP comfortable. A couple remaining asks:

- Can the invoice line that shows the discount also include a short memo (<= 80 chars) like "BAND-A 2% sign discount" so our ERP parses it to the credit bucket?
- Our AP also wants a quarterly reconciliation statement (CSV) listing monthly invoice numbers, the tranche applied, gross amount, discount amount, and net amount. Can Redwood export that on the 15th day after each quarter closes?

If you confirm, I'll ask AP to issue the master PO this week using our template. Marcus (billing lead) will be the contact for any mapping questions — cc'd.

— Marcus
